verdict.rationale: Filee's CLI accepts files, wildcards or folders in one `filee convert` run (filee-docs-25), and the GUI converts 1 to 100 dropped files in parallel without one failure stopping the rest (filee-docs-6). Per-file outcomes are surfaced through `--json` result output and an exit code that distinguishes "some files failed" from "nothing failed" (filee-docs-26), with the CLI also documented on GitHub (filee-probe-3). Missing for 10: an explicit documented per-file JSON result schema (status and error per file), and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch runs.
